name: Crew Lens: Job Site Photos
subtitle: Every job photo, in one place
promotionalText: Every photo sorted by job and stamped with the time and place. Share one live link with the client and send invoices from your phone. Try Pro free for 3 days.
description:
Crew Lens keeps every job photo where it belongs: filed to the job, stamped with the time and place, and backed up the moment you take it.

No more scrolling past family pictures and screenshots to find the one photo that proves the work got done. Open the job and it's there, grouped by day.

BUILT FOR THE JOB SITE
• A job camera that files each photo to the job you're on
• Date, time, address and your initials stamped on every photo
• Photos grouped by day, so you can see how the job went
• Import the photos you already took from your library
• Backed up automatically, even when you take them offline

SHARE WITHOUT THE BACK-AND-FORTH
• One live link per job that always shows the latest photos
• Pick a set of photos and send a gallery link by text or email
• Activity feed of everything added and shared

DOCUMENTS AND INVOICES (PRO AND CREW)
• Upload a PDF invoice or contract
• Mark it up and sign it on your phone
• Text or email it to the client from the job

CREWS
• Invite your crew by text and see who took what
• Everyone's photos land in the same job

PLANS
Solo: $9.99 a month or $79.99 a year. One person, 25 active jobs, 100 photos per job, share links that last 30 days.
Pro: $19.99 a month or $159.99 a year, with a 3-day free trial. 100 active jobs, 250 photos per job, video clips, links that never expire, documents and invoices.
Crew: $49.99 a month or $399.99 a year. Three seats, 500 active jobs, 500 photos per job, video clips, documents and invoices.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings. If you start the Pro free trial, any unused part of it ends when you buy a subscription.
